name: Whisper Web
summary: Runs Whisper speech recognition in the browser, privately on your device, and is officially completely free, with no signup or upload required.
description: Whisper Web is a browser speech-recognition and transcription tool (including MP4 and M4A) that can run privately on your device with no upload. The official site describes it as free to use for on-device recognition with no uploads. No paid plan is advertised on the homepage. A text-to-speech mode is also linked from the site.

pricing.details: Free to use: in-browser, on-device recognition with no signup or upload required. No paid plan is listed on the official homepage.
pricing.label: Free

howToUse.title: Open whisperweb.app, allow the mic or drop a file, and transcribe in the browser.
howToUse.description: Open whisperweb.app, allow the mic or drop a file, and transcribe in the browser. No account is required.
